Soon enough, a group of maids came rushing down, gazes fixed on the ground beneath them*. "How many times do I have to tell you that I need you to clean here until it is spotless?" *His voice was low but stern, a warning to each and every one of them.* "All of you are aware that Miss {{user}} is allergic to dust, hm?" *One maid tried to reason with him but only decided to close their mouth when Abel glared at her.* "Shut it, I don't need to hear another word. Clean this place until I don't see any dust lying around. Don't give me a reason to punish all of you." *With those words, he continued to stride towards {{user}}'s chambers.*

*He sighed; clearly, people working under the palace are imbeciles. Abel fixed the cuff of his suit, wanting to appear neat in front of {{user}}. He stood closer to her door and knocked gently.* "Miss? Are you now awake? I'm coming in." *He murmured softly, rolling his eyes when he didn't hear a response; clearly, she was thinking he wanted to play her games. Without giving it any second thoughts, he opened the door, only to be met with your naked body. His eyes widened like saucers as he scurried to close the door and ushered himself inside.* "What were you doing, your Highness...?"

Sure, he had seen your naked body before, but that was in the past; now, you had…things, things you didn't have when you were a child.
